zh.title: 行政院指派代理人維持運作 NCC優先核發航空器及船舶執照
zh.summary: NCC指派代表人維持運作；優先處理射頻器材進口與航空器執照核發
body: 國家通訊傳播委員會（NCC）自2026年8月1日起因委員任期屆滿而進入無委員空窗期。為維持機關基本運作，行政院已於8月13日指派NCC主任秘書溫俊瑜為機關代表人，後續將依規定處理相關業務。
NCC於8月17日表示，考量公共利益與民眾權益，將優先盡速辦理涉及民眾日常生活與重大公益之事項，包括電信管制射頻器材的進口核准，以及船舶與航空器執照的核發與換發業務。
先前在欠缺機關代表人的情況下，行政公文及執照案件均無法發文，累積待核發之公文達280件，射頻器材核准函與執照案件達269件。代理人將盡速核發相關證照，以確保業務順暢運作。

en.title: Executive Yuan Appoints Representative as NCC Prioritizes Aircraft License Issuance
en.summary: Taiwan NCC will prioritize processing radio frequency import approvals and aircraft station licenses under an appointed representative.
body: Taiwan's Executive Yuan appointed National Communications Commission (NCC) Chief Secretary Wen Jun-yu as the agency representative on August 13, 2026. The appointment aims to maintain basic agency operations during a vacancy period following the expiration of commissioners' terms at the end of July.

The NCC announced on August 17 that it will prioritize processing matters concerning public interest and daily life. Key authorized tasks include import approvals for controlled telecommunications radio frequency equipment, as well as the issuance and renewal of station licenses for vessels and aircraft.

Prior to the appointment of the official representative, document processing and official issuance had stalled. Accumulated backlogs included 280 official administrative documents and 269 cases involving radio frequency equipment approvals and station licenses.

zh.title: 英國斯托瑪里斯航展飛機表演受損 飛行員重傷送醫
zh.summary: 一架Druine D.31飛機於英國航展表演受損，機上飛行員身受重傷送醫。
body: 英國埃塞克斯郡斯托瑪里斯偉大戰爭機場於2026年8月16日舉行航空展期間，一架單座Druine D.31 Turbulent飛機在進行飛行表演時受損。主辦單位隨即叫停活動，並關閉園區向公眾開放的區域。
機上唯一的飛行員身受重傷，隨後被送往倫敦的醫院接受治療。埃塞克斯郡警察局與英格蘭東部救護車服務機構於當地時間14時25分前接獲報案並前往處置，警方表示現場未接獲其他人員受傷報告。
英國航空事故調查局（AAIB）表示已接獲通報，將派遣調查員進行初步評估。涉事飛機屬於由Tiger Club營運的Turbulent表演隊，機場方面表明將全力配合調查機構與緊急救援單位。

en.title: Druine Turbulent pilot seriously injured in UK Stow Maries Air Show display crash
en.summary: A Druine D.31 Turbulent pilot was seriously injured during an air show display performance in Essex, UK.
body: On August 16, 2026, a single-seat Druine D.31 Turbulent aircraft was damaged during a display performance at the Stow Maries Air Show in Essex, United Kingdom. Organizers halted the event immediately following the incident and closed the Stow Maries Great War Aerodrome site to the public.

The aircraft's sole occupant pilot sustained serious injuries and was transported to a London hospital for treatment. Emergency personnel from Essex Police and the East of England Ambulance Service responded to the scene shortly after 14:25 local time, with police reporting no ground injuries.

The UK Air Accidents Investigation Branch (AAIB) confirmed it will deploy an inspector to conduct an initial assessment. The aircraft belongs to the Turbulent Display Team, operated by the Tiger Club, and aerodrome management stated it is cooperating with authorities.

zh.title: 安哥拉航空以737貨機自南非運送兩隻獅子至奈及利亞
zh.summary: 安哥拉航空於8月以貨機將兩隻獅子自南非約翰尼斯堡運抵奈及利亞拉哥斯。
body: 安哥拉國家航空（TAAG Angola Airlines）於2026年8月15日表示，該公司於同月早些時候完成了一項特殊的貨運任務，將兩隻成年獅子從南非約翰尼斯堡（JNB）運送至奈及利亞拉哥斯（LOS）。
這兩隻獅子每隻重約200公斤，由波音737-800F貨機載運，途中經由安哥拉羅安達的安東尼奧·阿戈什蒂紐·內圖博士國際機場（NBJ）樞紐進行轉運。獅子在運送前原本由南非野生動物專家照料，隨後被送往拉哥斯的動物園設施，以便在安全且受控的環境中接受照顧。
安哥拉航空指出，這項任務的順利完成，展示了新啟用的安東尼奧·阿戈什蒂紐·內圖博士國際機場作為高價值及特殊貨物轉運樞紐的營運能力，該機場於2023年底開放貨運航班營運。航空公司的貨運子公司TAAG Cargo也在非洲營運定期貨運服務，航點包含羅安達至拉哥斯、布拉薩市、阿必尚、阿克拉、金夏沙、奈洛比、約翰尼斯堡與路沙卡等地。
安哥拉航空強調，本次運送因其特殊性質以及特殊的營運與法規要求而備受關注。截至2026年8月，該航空公司營運兩架專用貨機，包括一架波音737-800BCF，以及一架經ch-aviation列為非營運狀態的波音737-700QC。本次運送兩隻獅子至奈及利亞的任務即由波音737-800BCF負責執行，該機型亦為該航空公司在非洲區域運載各類貨物的主要貨運主力機型。

en.title: TAAG Angola Airlines Transports Two Lions From South Africa to Nigeria
en.summary: TAAG Angola Airlines transported two adult lions from Johannesburg to Lagos via Luanda in August 2026.
body: Angolan flag carrier TAAG Angola Airlines announced on August 15, 2026, that it had successfully completed a special air freight mission earlier in the month, transporting two adult lions from Johannesburg (JNB), South Africa, to Lagos (LOS), Nigeria.

The two lions, each weighing approximately 200 kilograms, were carried aboard a Boeing 737-800F freighter. The shipment was routed through the airline's primary hub at Dr. António Agostinho Neto International Airport (NBJ) in Luanda, Angola. Prior to the transport, the animals were in the care of wildlife specialists in South Africa, and they were transferred to a zoological facility in Lagos to be cared for within a secure and controlled environment.

TAAG Angola Airlines highlighted the completion of the flight as an example of the operational possibilities offered by Dr. António Agostinho Neto International Airport, which opened for cargo operations in late 2023 as a trans-shipment point for high-value and special cargo. The airline's cargo division, TAAG Cargo, conducts regular air freight operations across the African continent, operating dedicated cargo services from Luanda to Lagos, Brazzaville, Abidjan, Accra, Kinshasa, Nairobi, Johannesburg, and Lusaka.

According to the airline, this specific transport stood out due to its unusual nature and special operational and regulatory requirements. As of August 2026, the Angolan carrier operates two dedicated freight aircraft: a Boeing 737-700QC, which ch-aviation lists as inactive, and a Boeing 737-800BCF. The Boeing 737-800BCF was the specific aircraft used to move the two lions to Nigeria and serves as the airline's primary cargo aircraft for transporting various freight types across Africa.
